scenes.headline:
You can price it in ten minutes.
Then you type it all day
card: retyped for the rest of the day
scenes.say: Somewhere right now there's an underwriter who can price a risk in ten minutes, and spends the day typing it into three different places.

scenes.headline: You retype it. You wait. / And you rate it blind
scenes.say: You retype the proposal form. You wait three days for a referral. And the file you are rating has no history on it.

scenes.headline: A general insurance agency. / Opening now
scenes.sub: Chaguanas, Central Trinidad. One underwriting seat.
scenes.say: We are opening a general insurance agency, here in Chaguanas.

scenes.headline: Motor, property, liability. / A real commercial book
scenes.say: Motor, property, liability, engineering, marine and bonds. A real commercial book.

scenes.headline: Every term since the policy began

check: already on the screen when you open it

scenes.say: Before you open a file, every term since the policy began is already on the screen. What was covered, at what value, what was paid, and the claims that fell in each term.

scenes.headline: Read for you, / and checked against our record

bill.out: The desk says so, before you quote

scenes.say: The insurer's notice is read for you, and every figure is checked against our own record. Where the two disagree, the desk says so.

scenes.eyebrow: The part most underwriters never get
scenes.headline: A rule is not a ticket. / It is a decision

script.rhead: Here · the rule, in the desk

scenes.say: Here is the part most underwriters never get. A rule you decide is not a ticket at head office. It is written into the desk, and it runs on every file that week.

scenes.eyebrow: Rules you would write in your first month
scenes.headline: Yours, running on every file
cards: over a value you set, a trade you choose
when the declared value stops moving
the premium against the claims in the term
scenes.say: Your own referral rules. A flag that fires when the declared value stops moving. A rating check the client never has to ask for.

scenes.headline: The paperwork is finished. / The underwriting is not

r: not settled — and that is yours
split.line: How this agency underwrites is the part we want you for.

scenes.say: The paperwork is finished. The underwriting is not. That is the job.

scenes.urlsub:
Your CV and fifteen minutes.
Read by the Branch Manager alone.
scenes.say: One seat, for an underwriter. Chaguanas. Come and build the book.
